skill.name: deliverability-qa
skill.description: Reviews pre-send email authentication, reputation, inbox placement, content risks, and list hygiene from user-supplied evidence. Produces SEND-S scoring, S1 status, and explicit evidence gaps.
skill.summary: Run an evidence-based email deliverability preflight before sending.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and fixed relative documentation links. Two lines explicitly invoke external Python connectors for Resend and DNS-over-HTTPS checks. The connector implementations are outside this scanned package, so their behavior cannot be verified here.

remediation.issue: External connector commands are not included in the scanned skill package.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle and audit connector scripts, pin their paths, disclose network destinations, and require user confirmation before execution.

remediation.issue: The Resend connector requires an account API key.
remediation.suggestion: Use a least-privilege key, keep it in environment storage, and ensure the connector never logs or returns the credential.

content.value_statement: Email authentication, reputation, placement, and list hygiene issues can derail a campaign before launch. This skill reviews supplied evidence and produces a scored preflight with explicit gaps.
actual_capabilities: Reviews supplied DNS and DMARC evidence for SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and BIMI status.
Interprets domain and IP reputation, seed-list placement, bounce rates, and complaint rates.
Checks supplied email creative for spam phrasing, image balance, link, plain-text, and rendering concerns.
Marks each deliverability item as pass, partial, fail, or needs input.
Calculates a SEND-S score and assigns an S1 authentication status.
Prepares a structured handoff for a broader email quality audit.
limitations: Reliable results require current DNS, DMARC, ESP, reputation, and seed-test evidence.
DNS records alone cannot prove that SPF and DKIM align on real message traffic.
The skill does not compute the final EQS or enforce final sending vetoes.
Referenced connector scripts and parent repository documents are not included in this two-file package.

use_cases.title: Campaign Launch Preflight
use_cases.description: Review authentication, reputation, placement, and list health before a scheduled campaign.

use_cases.title: Inbox Placement Diagnosis
use_cases.description: Compare seed-test results and creative risks when messages reach Promotions or spam.

use_cases.title: Client Deliverability Review
use_cases.description: Create a consistent evidence-based assessment across client domains and ESP exports.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Preflight
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a deliverability preflight for [domain] using the evidence I provide. Mark every missing input clearly and do not assume a pass.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review before a planned send

prompt_templates.title: Authentication Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, and DMARC aggregate results for [domain]. Explain alignment issues and assign the S1 status.

prompt_templates.title: Placement and Content Diagnosis
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this seed-list result, ESP report, and email creative. Identify placement, reputation, link, content, and rendering risks with specific evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate investigation of Promotions or spam placement

prompt_templates.title: Full SEND-S Assessment
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate [domain] for the [profile] profile using these DNS, RUA, reputation, seed-test, creative, bounce, complaint, and consent records. Score SEND-S and prepare the auditor handoff.

output_examples.input: Audit example.com for a newsletter send. The DNS export has SPF and DKIM, but no DMARC record.
output_examples.output: S1 is veto-candidate because no DMARC record is present. SPF and DKIM still need real-traffic alignment evidence from a DMARC aggregate report.

output_examples.input: Review a campaign with aligned authentication and no seed-list test or reputation report.
output_examples.output: Authentication passes on supplied evidence. Inbox placement and reputation remain NEEDS_INPUT, so the sending signal is not fully verified.

output_examples.input: Diagnose an email with shortened links, no plain-text part, and a 0.18 percent complaint rate.
output_examples.output: The report flags shortened links and the missing plain-text part. The complaint rate is partial and requires corrective action before scale-up.

best_practices: Provide current evidence from the exact domain, ESP, and campaign being reviewed.
Include a DMARC aggregate report because DNS setup alone cannot prove passing alignment.
Treat every missing source as needs input and keep final veto decisions with the full auditor.
anti_patterns: Do not mark authentication as passing from record presence alone.
Do not invent reputation or inbox placement results when reports are missing.
Do not use this one-time snapshot as a recurring list hygiene monitor.

faq.question: What evidence should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide DNS records, a DMARC aggregate report, ESP metrics, reputation data, a seed-list test, and the campaign creative.

faq.question: Can this skill verify DKIM from DNS alone?
faq.answer: It can verify record setup. Passing alignment on real traffic requires message or DMARC aggregate evidence.

faq.question: Does this skill make the final send decision?
faq.answer: No. It scores SEND-S and flags S1, while the broader email quality auditor applies final veto rules.

faq.question: Can it diagnose Promotions tab placement?
faq.answer: It can assess supplied seed-test, reputation, content, link, and rendering evidence. It cannot guarantee placement by mailbox providers.

faq.question: Does it monitor list health over time?
faq.answer: No. It reads a point-in-time bounce and complaint snapshot, not recurring trends or suppression drift.

faq.question: Will it run connector scripts automatically?
faq.answer: The instructions reference optional connectors, but their scripts are outside this package. Execution should require user approval and an audited installation.
